jobs.description: Ready to kickstart your workday in a dynamic environment? As a warehouse worker, you play a crucial role in the logistics process. You will be working at a client of ours in Hoofddorp, the absolute specialist in exotic products. This is a stable position where you can truly build for the long term! You start the day with a fresh cup of coffee, have a quick, to-the-point check-in with your team leader, and dive straight into the warehouse. From collecting orders on the EPT to getting freight ready for transport: you stay physically active, keep an overview, and work together with your team to supply stores and customers on time. Tasks:  -  Order picking exotic products in various storage locations efficiently and safely.  -  Operating an EPT to move goods quickly and safely through the warehouse.  -  Moving freight and stock to loading docks, storage areas, and delivery vehicles.  -  Stacking and packing goods neatly for safe shipment.  -  Keeping the work environment clean, organized, and safe.  -  Working closely with your team and coordinating with connected stores.  -  Working longer hours on busy days whenever you want to.   What we are looking for:  -  A true doer who is physically in great shape and loves to roll up their sleeves.  -  An EPT certificate is required (don't have one yet? We will arrange it for you!).  -  You are looking for stability and a long-term commitment.  -  Available for the fixed working hours from 06:00 to 15:00.  -  Willing to work two Saturdays per month from 06:00 to 11:00.  -  Ability to stay organized and perform well under pressure during peak times.  -  Good communication skills in Dutch or English to understand work instructions.  -  Living in or near Hoofddorp, such as Amsterdam, Aalsmeer, Haarlem, or Nieuw-Vennep.   What we offer:  -  An attractive salary that perfectly matches your effort and experience.  -  A great 50% allowance on all hours worked on Saturday!

Do you have experience in logistics as an order picker, or would you like to gain it? Then this is the job for you! In this role as an order picker, you are jointly responsible for ensuring that supermarkets are stocked with all kinds of products. Before the products reach the stores, you have already handled them in the distribution center.In this position, you will be involved in various all-round logistics activities. For instance, using a voice-picking system, you will collect specific products and quantities to be stocked for the different supermarkets. You pack the goods neatly to prevent damage, after which the full roll containers are collected and delivered to the dispatch department. Although the orders are collected using the order picking truck, the products must be placed on the truck by hand. Therefore, it is important that you are capable of performing physical work. What kind of products and weights are we talking about? This warehouse contains fast-moving goods, such as wine, crates of beer, cat food, chips, and best-selling (and therefore fast-moving) hand soap dispensers. Both part-time and full-time are possible for this position; a weekend day (Saturday/Sunday) is a requirement.- You speak fluent Dutch or English- You have experience in logistics as an order picker or would like to gain this experience- You are able to perform physical work- Available for at least one day during the weekend
